about.title: I’d rather own an outcome than tick a task.
paras: I live on my own in Burgas and run my life the way I run AGility: I decide, I own it, and I fix what breaks.
I’m a high-school student at VSCPI, specialising in AI programming. School gives me the fundamentals: Python, NumPy, Pandas, regression. AGility is where I prove them on real businesses.
I use AI tools like Claude Code and LLM APIs to ship fast, but I understand and own every system I build. When something breaks, I know where to look.
What I’m looking for: a remote team working on AI and automation, with real users and people I can learn from. AGility keeps running alongside school.
